principle: Class-E defects are production issues documented separately. They are NEVER silently fixed during test-strengthening. Each requires human authorization before any code change.

defects.description: The threshold calculation (avg * 250000) makes it mathematically impossible for any transaction to ever be flagged as 'large'. For N transactions: threshold = avg * 250000 = sum/N * 250000. A transaction X > threshold requires X(N - 250000) > rest_sum * 250000, which is impossible for any realistic N.

evidence.mathematical_proof: X > (sum/N)*250000 → X*N > sum*250000 → X(N-250000) > rest_sum*250000. For N<<250000, LHS<0, RHS>0 → contradiction.

defects.proposed_action: Fix the threshold formula or accept that no transactions can be flagged (documented limitation). Requires human review.
